text:
alex: Quick async update — hotpath interop + owners digest. High level: kernel work, continuous batching, KV warmup. I assigned owners but need confirmations and blockers.

maria: I own kernel. landed perf PR to feature branch, CI failing one flaky test (segfault when batch_size>64). looking into it. @devops-bot can you confirm infra quota for canary?

devops-bot: infra update: increased GPU node pool by 10% for canary. quota change applied at 15:20 UTC.

sam: batching status: continuous-batching prototype merged to my branch. CPU numbers look good; need a GPU run to validate. blocked on kernel API for kv-prefetch handshake — @maria is the API stable?

maria: API is stable. small rename incoming: prefetch_window -> lookahead, but alias stays so backward-compatible. rename PR ETA: EOD tomorrow.

kai: KV warmup: warmup job script ready. synthetic run shows ~12% token latency drop. still tuning eviction heuristics with @rita. need runtime traces to validate traces join. @rita can you attach latest trace schema?

rita: attached: /files/runtime_traces/v3/schema.json — note I deprecated two fields, parser has fallback.

sam: milestone check — can we list explicit dates so downstream teams (ML, infra) can plan?

alex: Milestones: (1) kernel CI green + canary GPU run — target Thu, (2) batching GPU run + perf validation — target Fri, (3) kv warmup canary + trace validation — target Mon. Owners: kernel=maria, batching=sam, kv=kai. Dependencies: infra quota (done), trace schema (done), ML workload parity (ML team). @maria @sam confirm?

maria: Thu works if I can repro CI segfault; blocking window 9-11am to debug.

sam: Friday OK. I'll schedule GPU run after kernel canary completes and post perf dashboard link.

kai: Monday OK for canary. planning a 5% traffic ramp then 25% then 50% if stable. need rollout doc.

alex: rollout plan approved: 5 / 25 / 50 ramp. CR pings: @maria please review my comments on sam's batching PR (link in review). @sam add a small smoke test to batching CI to catch regressions.

sam: will add smoke test today.

rita: one more ask — add a trace_id header on batch_start event so KV can join spans. @maria can kernel emit that?

maria: yep, kernel will emit trace_id on batch_start; I'll include in the rename PR.

devops-bot: Canary deployed to env-staging at 16:02 UTC — /canaries/hotpath-3601239876

alex: Thanks. If no blockers I'll mark this resolved by EOD. anything else?

sam: left a code comment on kernel PR about concurrency safety. not a blocker but worth looking at. :eyes:

maria: saw it, will reply this afternoon.

kai: prepping rollout doc, will post in #eng-runtime tomorrow morning.

alex: perfect, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
